ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity distribution dominated by dark pixels; high-intensity white/light-grey pixels constitute approximately 5% of the visible surface area, primarily localized at distal tips and small scattered points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity black contiguous field across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white/light-grey circular and annular features (5-15 pixel diameter) are sparsely mapped across the surface, with a higher spatial frequency on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels creating a continuous jagged linear edge, terminating in high-amplitude irregularities at distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the medial notch axis to the distal tips on both the left and right fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular and annular high-contrast light clusters (scars) distributed across both lobes, appearing as localized disruptions in the uniform dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant high-contrast brown and white clusters of barnacle colonization (Coronula spp.) localized at the distal tips of both lobes; extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely ragged and irregular distal tip morphology resulting from dense crustacean attachment, distinct from the smoother trailing edge serrations.
